crime: Every evening by the lounge fire, one prisoner altered the other girls' dresses with pins and shears. She left every old stain in. "A stain is where a dress has lived," she said.

{WITCH_NAME} handed her the pins. The tailor was the only girl she let stand that close, and the only one she never let fit her. Before anyone could look at her, {WITCH_NAME} passed her palm over herself and wiped away every crease and stain, so no one looked long enough to find anything.

At nine, the others left their rumpled dresses on the sofa for pressing and went. {WITCH_NAME} stayed for her first fitting. At five past, the tailor pinned her dress, unpinned it, pinned it again, then took the pins out. "Something's not right. It isn't the dress. Come back another night."
"Something's not right," {WITCH_NAME}'s mother used to say before every outing, putting her daughter into one outfit after another. Then she would go out and leave her at home.

At eight past nine, {WITCH_NAME} drove the shears into the tailor's chest. At ten past, she wiped the blood off herself with her palm, ran it over every dress until each lay smooth as if pressed, and hung them up. She set the flatiron in the fireplace coals to heat. At a quarter past nine she joined the game at the pool table in the recreation room, spotless.
At ten to ten, the prisoners found the tailor dead, every dress pressed and the iron hot. She must have kept pressing for half an hour after {WITCH_NAME} left.

In the trial court, one prisoner found her pressed dress as good as new: the old stain the tailor had left in it was gone. An iron lifts no stain, the prisoners realized. The dresses had been smoothed after the tailor died, under {WITCH_NAME}'s palm.
fields.epitaph: She killed the one girl who never held a mark against anyone.
execution: On the execution stand hangs a giant copy of her spotless dress, and she hangs inside it by the shoulders. Giant needles wait along its open side seams, already threaded.
The needles begin to stitch the seams shut. With every pull of thread, the bodice draws tighter around her ribs. Each time a seam is finished, the needles unpick it and sew it again, tighter.
At last she hangs still inside the dress, fitted, without a single crease.

magic.name: Good as New
magic.text: A pass of her palm wipes scars, stains, scratches and creases from skin, cloth or any surface.
